verdict.rationale: Evidence shows PayPal implements third-party protocols (OpenAI's ACP, Google's UCP) and references an 'ACP agentic checkout specification,' but nothing describes those specs as openly published, versioned, or implementable without approval — instead, access to PayPal's own agentic commerce services is explicitly form-gated ('complete a form... request access... AI team will follow up'), and UCP enablement requires contacting Google. No evidence confirms the protocol documents themselves are freely readable/versioned without signing anything.
